figures.title: Chapter map
figures.why: one idea - when external forces vanish the COM coasts and momentum survives
figures.read: every result is a COM position, a momentum balance, or an e-bookkeeping

figures.title: The COM: an isolated system coasts
figures.why: internal forces cancel in pairs, so nothing inside can steer the system
figures.data: R = Σ m_i r_i / M; exploding shell keeps its parabola
figures.read: the COM is the one point you can always trust

figures.title: Impulse: the area that changes momentum
figures.why: collisions are too brief to track the force; we trade shape for area
figures.data: J = ∫F dt = Δp; average force = J/Δt
figures.read: the same momentum change hurts more when it happens fast

figures.title: Collisions: momentum always, kinetic energy sometimes
figures.why: the one rule that survives and the one that does not
figures.data: momentum conserved; e = v_sep/v_app: 1 elastic, 0 stick, between otherwise
figures.read: momentum is non-negotiable; e decides how much KE survives

figures.title: The energy loss: the (1 - e²) rule
figures.why: one formula prices every imperfect collision
figures.data: ΔK = ½μ(u1-u2)²(1-e²); zero at e=1, maximal at e=0
figures.read: reduced mass and approach speed set the stakes; (1-e²) sets the loss

figures.title: Triage - route by the keyword
figures.why: the keyword names the route before any number is touched
figures.read: explosions ride the COM, collisions balance momentum against e
